column1: # Outcomes of an unreadable row domain/relay-for (ADR-0088 addendum (1) R7, addendum (2) S11). A row: path<TAB>reader<TAB>outcome<TAB>priority<TAB>unit<TAB>norm.
# path — the refusal path (JSON Pointer; "" — the whole row); priority — smaller is earlier; unit — the unit of unreadability.

column3: the whole row is unreadable: the agent rewrites it on the version read with the next relay_for
the whole row is unreadable: the worker — the action that needs the row is not performed in this pass, the cause goes to the log
